_comment: sim/input-offset (systematic half) as a `klt sim` request (issue #97): T1 item 5 coverage for the ratified input-referred-offset row.
Circuit: tb_offset.body.spice -- the same test circuit as ../testbench/tb_offset_null.spice.tmpl, the harness's PRIMARY (null-sweep) method; the committed record's vos_null_v column comes from it.
Grid: cornerMOSlv.lib mos_tt/ss/ff/sf/fs [DR-1] x {-40, 27, 125} C x VDD {1.08, 1.20, 1.32} V = 45 corners; vinp (the common-mode source) sweeps WITH vdd by index, so Vcm = VDD/2 as in the harness.
Each process corner is a bundle carrying the template's fixed cornerCAP.lib cap_typ section.
Analysis: dc Vid 0.004 0.034 4u = 7501 points at the harness fine pass's 4 uV step, one pass (the harness's coarse locate + fine pass cannot be chained in a request; see the body header).

Ratified row: systematic input offset |Vos| <= 21.9 mV worst-case [DR-2] (spec/target-spec.md section 2): vos_null_v carries limits min -0.0219 / max 0.0219 (a magnitude bound written as a two-sided limit; no rounding or slack added, so a point at 21.93 mV is a miss).
vos_null_v = Vid at which v(out) = v(cm), first rising crossing, linearly interpolated by ngspice between adjacent sweep points (.meas dc ... when).

vos_crossings_n counts sign changes of v(orel) over the 7501-point sweep (mean of the per-interval sign-change indicator times the 7500 intervals; `sum` is a running sum in ngspice and does not reduce to a scalar) and must be exactly 1 (limits 0.5..1.5 only absorb float rounding of mean*7500) (the harness's unique-crossing rule; 0 means the null left the window).

gain_local_vv is the two-point slope dVout/dVid across the sweep interval that brackets the null (the one interval where orel changes sign), must be >= 10 V/V (the harness's >= 20 dB sanity rule); fd1/fd2/ftail at the null reproduce its rail-window rule [0.02, 0.98]*VDD.
The *_dc_v node voltages and gain_local_vv carry/ride no ratified bound beyond the sanity rules: they are reported for compare.py's join against the harness CSV.
The harness's second method (closed-loop output error referred back through the AC-record gain) is a cross-check, not the ratified number's source, and is NOT in this request.
options.timeout_s = 300 s per corner: a 7501-point DC sweep of this circuit takes seconds.
Solver tolerance: ngspice default, no .options reltol/abstol/vntol (DR-0005).
ngspice_init raises the print precision so the envelope values are not rounded to 6 digits.
